title: pilosella auriculina subsp. subteneriuscula
intro: Pilosella auriculina subsp. subteneriuscula, commonly known as a subspecies of the genus Pilosella, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella auriculina subsp. subteneriuscula include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and potential antimicrobial agent, which may be useful in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
